name: cumulative probabilities
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 随机变量取值不超过给定阈值的概率。
usage_note: 用于区分不同累积概率水平的不平顺功率谱密度。
usage_overview: 在轨道不平顺分析中，用于区分不同累积概率水平的不平顺功率谱密度，表征相应的不平顺状态，并比较这些状态下的轨道板离缝损伤。

complete_examples.text: Subsequently, with these parameters, the CP-PSDs can be mutually transformed among arbitrary cumulative probabilities.
Without loss of generality, the cumulative probability PSDs (CP- PSDs) are denoted as Ψ(λ, ω), in which λrepresents the vector of cumulative probabilities, ωrepresents the spatial frequencies.
